# go.modules and go.packages expand matrix targets: a test per package in
# each module, skipping modules under `_` and `testdata` and modules without
# packages, and a binary per command.
[!exec:go] skip

bit -ll
stdout '^tests\[".", "example\.com/root"\] \(go\.test\)$'
stdout '^tests\["svc", "example\.com/svc/api"\] \(go\.test\)$'
stdout '^tests\["svc", "example\.com/svc/db"\] \(go\.test\)$'
stdout '^bins\["example\.com/root/cmd/one"\] \(go\.exe\)$'
stdout '^bins\["example\.com/root/cmd/two"\] \(go\.exe\)$'
! stdout 'skip|testdata|tools|cmd/one", "'

bit
stdout 'tests\["svc", "example\.com/svc/api"\] ✔ PASS \./api '
grep '\A\.\nsvc\ntools\n\z' modules.txt
exec ./bin/one
stderr '\Aone\n\z'
exec ./bin/two
stderr '\Atwo\n\z'

# `modules` writes modules.txt into the root module. If that happened
# while the root tests ran, they run again here, as they never saw it.
bit
bit
! stdout '▶'

# A change in one module reruns only its slices.
cp api.go.changed svc/api/api.go
bit
stdout 'tests\["svc", "example\.com/svc/api"\] ▶'
! stdout 'tests\["svc", "example\.com/svc/db"\] ▶'
! stdout 'tests\[".", "example\.com/root"\] ▶'

-- BUILD.bit --
let module = go.modules()

tests[module, package = go.packages("./...", module)] = go.test {
  dir     = module
  package = package
}

bins[cmd = go.packages("./cmd/...")] = go.exe {
  package = cmd
  output  = "bin/#{cmd | basename}"
}

modules = exec {
  command = "printf '%s\n' #{go.modules() | shell_join} > modules.txt"
  outputs = ["modules.txt"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/root

go 1.22
-- root.go --
package root
-- cmd/one/main.go --
package main

func main() { println("one") }
-- cmd/two/main.go --
package main

func main() { println("two") }
-- svc/go.mod --
module example.com/svc

go 1.22
-- svc/api/api.go --
package api
-- api.go.changed --
package api

const Version = 2
-- svc/api/api_test.go --
package api

import "testing"

func TestAPI(t *testing.T) {}
-- svc/db/db.go --
package db
-- tools/go.mod --
module example.com/tools

go 1.22
-- _skip/go.mod --
module example.com/skip
-- testdata/mod/go.mod --
module example.com/td
